summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for the Arman Portfolio Full-Control CMS Upgrade. Covers the site_text universal string registry, section management, legal pages, SEO controls, live inline editing with floating pill toggle, video link auto-fill, project custom fields and bulk actions, theme color customization with WCAG AA validation, media library management, JSON backup and version history, owner/editor multi-tier roles, and non-destructive Supabase migrations.
